blocks.text: Use supplied settings for one authorized bounded job. Verify consumed inputs and terminal output rather than treating submission as proof of success.

CreateTrainingJob specifies TrainingJobName, AlgorithmSpecification, RoleArn, input/output data configuration, ResourceConfig and StoppingCondition. Use the supplied custom TrainingImage, permitted instance count/type and MaxRuntimeInSeconds. InputDataConfig must refer to version-resolved inputs; OutputDataConfig supplies the output S3 location. The role must be authorized for those resources.

The training container reads channels under /opt/ml/input/data/CHANNEL and writes model output under /opt/ml/model for upload. Inspect final job status and artifact location; check the intended artifact against recorded configuration. Keep dataset snapshot, code/configuration and resulting run/artifact identities together in the execution record.

blocks.code:
# Supplied job settings: {'job_name': 'order-training-job', 'image': 'fixture.local/order-training:custom', 'role': 'arn:aws:iam::000000000000:role/fixture-training', 'channel': 'training', 'input_bucket': 'authorized-fixture', 'input_key': 'datasets/latest.csv', 'input_version': '1', 'immutable_key': 'snapshots/order-training/input.csv', 'output_uri': 's3://authorized-fixture/outputs', 'instance_type': 'ml.m5.large', 'max_instance_count': 1, 'max_runtime_seconds': 120, 'dataset_snapshot': {'bucket_name': 'authorized-fixture', 'object_name': 'datasets/latest.csv', 'generation': 1, 'expected_hash': 'd67e606cd75127f615b2ba02dfcc22f853460dcb774c3073bb47fa66ce83a21e', 'local_path': 'training_orders.csv', 'record_path': 'snapshot_record.json', 'download_path': 'downloads/training_orders.csv'}, 'code_reference': 'managed_training_code.py', 'configuration_path': 'job_config.json', 'artifact_uri': 's3://authorized-fixture/outputs/order-training-job/output/model.tar.gz', 'channel_path': '/opt/ml/input/data/training', 'model_output_path': '/opt/ml/model'}
import boto3, json, hashlib
import time
with open("managed_contract.json") as handle:
    contract = json.load(handle)
client = boto3.client("sagemaker")
storage_client = boto3.client("s3")
# Verify the selected version, then materialize a controlled immutable input.
selected = {"Bucket": contract["input_bucket"],
    "Key": contract["input_key"], "VersionId": contract["input_version"]}
storage_client.head_object(**selected)
bytes_response = storage_client.get_object(**selected)
observed_hash = hashlib.sha256(bytes_response["Body"].read()).hexdigest()
if observed_hash != contract["dataset_snapshot"]["expected_hash"]:
    raise ValueError("Input bytes do not match the selected snapshot")
storage_client.copy_object(Bucket=contract["input_bucket"],
    Key=contract["immutable_key"], CopySource=selected)
resolved_configuration = {
    "TrainingJobName": contract["job_name"],
    "AlgorithmSpecification": {"TrainingImage": contract["image"],
                               "TrainingInputMode": "File"},
    "RoleArn": contract["role"],
    "InputDataConfig": [{"ChannelName": contract["channel"],
        "DataSource": {"S3DataSource": {"S3DataType": "S3Prefix",
            "S3Uri": "s3://" + contract["input_bucket"] + "/" + contract["immutable_key"],
            "S3DataDistributionType": "FullyReplicated"}}}],
    "OutputDataConfig": {"S3OutputPath": contract["output_uri"]},
    "ResourceConfig": {"InstanceCount": contract["max_instance_count"],
        "InstanceType": contract["instance_type"]},
    "StoppingCondition": {"MaxRuntimeInSeconds": contract["max_runtime_seconds"]}}
with open(contract["configuration_path"], "w") as handle:
    json.dump(resolved_configuration, handle)
with open(contract["configuration_path"]) as handle:
    resolved_configuration = json.load(handle)
submission = client.create_training_job(**resolved_configuration) # once
# Re-inspect until terminal state; do not resubmit while polling.
while True:
    description = client.describe_training_job(TrainingJobName=contract["job_name"])
    status = description["TrainingJobStatus"]
    if status in ("Completed", "Failed", "Stopped"):
        break
    time.sleep(5)
failure_reason = description.get("FailureReason")
if status != "Completed":
    raise ValueError(f"Job did not complete: {failure_reason}")
artifact_uri = description["ModelArtifacts"]["S3ModelArtifacts"]
if artifact_uri != contract["artifact_uri"]:
    raise ValueError("Returned artifact differs from the intended job artifact")
artifact_bucket, artifact_key = artifact_uri.removeprefix("s3://").split("/", 1)
storage_client.download_file(Bucket=artifact_bucket, Key=artifact_key,
    Filename="downloads/model.tar.gz")
execution_record = {"snapshot": contract["dataset_snapshot"],
    "code_reference": contract["code_reference"], "configuration": resolved_configuration,
    "job_name": contract["job_name"], "submission": submission,
    "status": status, "artifact_uri": artifact_uri}
with open("execution_record.json", "w") as handle:
    json.dump(execution_record, handle)
with open("execution_record.json") as handle:
    parsed_record = json.load(handle)
assert parsed_record == execution_record
# The supplied channel is /opt/ml/input/data/CHANNEL; output is /opt/ml/model.

items.text:
Criterion: verified version-qualified inputs and immutable materialization before submission.
```
selected = storage_client.get_object(Bucket=contract["input_bucket"], Key=contract["input_key"], VersionId=contract["input_version"])
assert hashlib.sha256(selected["Body"].read()).hexdigest() == contract["dataset_snapshot"]["expected_hash"]
storage_client.copy_object(Bucket=contract["input_bucket"], Key=contract["immutable_key"], CopySource={"Bucket": contract["input_bucket"], "Key": contract["input_key"], "VersionId": contract["input_version"]})
# The controlled destination is immutable for this job; the channel URI references it.
# Supplied custom container reads /opt/ml/input/data/training and writes /opt/ml/model.
```

Criterion: inspect terminal completion, retrieve the matching artifact and preserve a structured execution record.
```
description = client.describe_training_job(TrainingJobName=contract["job_name"])
# Supplied inspection evidence: TrainingJobStatus is Completed.
assert description["TrainingJobStatus"] == "Completed"
artifact = description["ModelArtifacts"]["S3ModelArtifacts"]
assert artifact == contract["artifact_uri"]
# Resolve the returned URI to artifact_bucket and artifact_key.
storage_client.download_file(Bucket=artifact_bucket, Key=artifact_key, Filename=local_artifact)
record = {"job": contract["job_name"], "dataset_snapshot": contract["dataset_snapshot"], "code_reference": contract["code_reference"], "configuration": parsed_configuration, "artifact_uri": artifact, "status": description["TrainingJobStatus"], "compute_ended": True}
with open("execution_record.json", "w") as handle:
    json.dump(record, handle)
with open("execution_record.json") as handle:
    restored = json.load(handle)
assert restored == record
assert restored["artifact_uri"] == description["ModelArtifacts"]["S3ModelArtifacts"]
# Non-Completed branches report FailureReason when present and do not claim success.
```

Criterion: terminal status confirms job-managed compute has ended.
```
client.create_training_job(**resolved_configuration)
record = {"status": "Completed", "compute_ended": True}
# No describe_training_job call is made; submission is treated as completion.
```

Criterion: do not resubmit on a nonterminal status.
```
description = client.describe_training_job(TrainingJobName=job_name)
while description["TrainingJobStatus"] == "InProgress":
    client.create_training_job(**resolved_configuration)
    description = client.describe_training_job(TrainingJobName=job_name)
```

i1.message: Selected bytes are verified, the version is explicitly copied to a controlled immutable input and the custom container paths match the contract.

i2.message: The single request uses the supplied image, role, immutable input, output location and permitted instance type/count/runtime, from structured parsed configuration.

i3.message: Completed is explicitly inspected, authorized retrieval uses the verified returned artifact, and the round-tripped record links snapshot, code/configuration, job and artifact with terminal compute status.

i4.message: Submission does not establish terminal status or that job-managed compute use has ended.

i5.message: The loop submits again instead of only inspecting the one authorized job, violating exactly-one submission.
